_doc: Hand-built skill_near data for the golden case near-rank (matcher 1.1.0, owner decision O2). Not real data. Systems analysis (skl:2.B.4.g) has five neighbours. Its 3 closest are skl:2.A.2.a (0.97), skl:2.C.4.a (0.95) and Java (0.95; third, because skl:2.C.4.a sorts before tec:java on the tie). SQL (0.94) is fourth, so it never credits systems analysis. Computers and electronics (skl:2.C.3.a) has one neighbour at 0.89, under the 0.90 floor. Quality control (skl:2.B.3.m) has one at exactly 0.90, which counts.
